subject: EU residency assurances for Cloud Marketplace onboarding - SIG & CAIQ questionnaire
messages:
From: Lukas Schneider <lukas.schneider@medrec.io>
To: tessa_morgan@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@medrec.io
Date: 2026-08-29T09:17:00Z
Subject: SIG & CAIQ + EU-only processing confirmation for marketplace onboarding

Hi Tessa,

Thanks for the quick chat this morning. As discussed, MedRec Health is preparing to onboard Redwood to our EU-facing cloud marketplace and procurement needs the following from Redwood before we can proceed with legal review and a pilot: 

- Completed SIG questionnaire (we attached our standard ask) and a populated CAIQ where applicable.
- Confirmation in writing that production workloads for MedRec customers will be processed and stored in EU-only regions (SCCs/DPA language acceptable) OR a clear description of any permitted cross-border flows.
- Technical summary for the marketplace deployment path: private VPC connector options, key management (bring-your-own-key / HSM), and ingress/egress flow diagrams.
- Expected turnaround for the evidence bundle (SOC 2 report + SIG/CAIQ responses + VPC architecture doc).

Attaching: MedRec_SIG_CAIQ_Ask.pdf (list of fields we need filled + a short procurement checklist).

Procurement contact (please loop them in): procurement@medrec.io

Appreciate a quick confirmation of scope and ETA so we can map internal scheduling.

Best,
Lukas Schneider
Head of Platform Partnerships
MedRec Health

--- Attachment: MedRec_SIG_CAIQ_Ask.pdf (1 page, questionnaire stub) ---

From: tessa_morgan@redwood.com
To: Lukas Schneider <lukas.schneider@medrec.io>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, rafael_mendes@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-29T11:03:00Z
Subject: Re: SIG & CAIQ + EU-only processing confirmation for marketplace onboarding

Hi Lukas,

Thanks — we'll take this as the formal intake. Quick confirmation of scope from our side: Redwood can produce a SIG/CAIQ response, provide SOC 2 evidence (attestation or summary), and a VPC marketplace deployment summary. For the EU-only processing commitment, we need to align contract language (DPA + SCCs) with Legal; we can provide a routing and data residency attestation for production tenants pinned to EU regions.

Next steps I propose:
- Rafael will draft a short VPC architecture summary and a list of technical controls by EOD 2026-08-31.
- Marissa will confirm contractual DPA/SCCs language and estimated legal review timeline by 2026-09-02.
- I will populate the SIG/CAIQ scaffold and return an initial pass of answers by 2026-09-01.

Can you confirm: (1) the HubSpot/contract record (HS id) to reference, and (2) whether MedRec requires a managed BYOK option or if KMS with customer-managed keys in the marketplace is sufficient for the initial pilot?

Looping in procurement per your note.

Thanks,
Tessa Morgan
Senior Strategic Sales Manager
Redwood Inference
T: +1 415-555-0123

From: rafael_mendes@redwood.com
To: tessa_morgan@redwood.com, Lukas Schneider <lukas.schneider@medrec.io>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-30T08:12:00Z
Subject: Re: SIG & CAIQ + EU-only processing confirmation for marketplace onboarding

Hi all,

Technical clarifications from the infra/security side:

- Marketplace path: we support a private connector pattern for marketplace integrations. Production workloads can be restricted to EU regions (we operate in multiple AZs within eu-west-1 and eu-central-1).
- Data flows: model inference requests may traverse control-plane endpoints (metadata) that are global by default; customer data (input/output) can be pinned and stored in EU-only storage buckets. We'll document the exact control-plane telemetry and what is considered customer data.
- KMS: we offer two options — Redwood-managed KMS with regionally scoped keys, or BYOK via customer KMS with HSM-backed keys for Dedicated/Private deployments. Marketplace offerings usually start with regionally-scoped Redwood KMS and can transition to BYOK for production commitments.
- SCCs/DPA: we can provide standard European Commission SCCs and a redlined DPA; legal can confirm required revisions.

I'll attach a short technical summary that covers network topology, routing, and expected artifact list for the evidence bundle. If procurement needs an operations runbook (how onboarding and failover work), we can produce that as an add-on.

Available for a 30-min technical call — suggested times: 2026-09-01 09:00-11:00 CET or 2026-09-02 14:00-16:00 CET.

Regards,
Rafael Mendes
Head of Infrastructure Security
Redwood Inference

--- Attachment: Redwood_VPC_Technical_Summary.pdf (3 pages, topology diagram + control-plane notes) ---

From: Lukas Schneider <lukas.schneider@medrec.io>
To: rafael_mendes@redwood.com, tessa_morgan@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@medrec.io
Date: 2026-08-31T10:46:00Z
Subject: Re: SIG & CAIQ + EU-only processing confirmation for marketplace onboarding

Thanks Rafael — that all looks sensible. A couple of notes from procurement and legal side: 

- Procurement needs to see the populated CAIQ + SIG answers in spreadsheet form so our InfoSec can do a quick mapping. PDF is fine for the VPC summary, but the SIG/CAIQ grid should be machine-parsable (spreadsheet or CSV).
- MedRec requires an explicit clause that production customer data for EU customers is stored and processed in EU-only regions; inter-region backups to non-EU are not permitted unless explicitly listed.
- BYOK is preferred for the pilot, but procurement said KMS with an option to upgrade to BYOK within 90 days is acceptable.

I've attached procurement_terms_medrec.pdf with our standard marketplace procurement checklist and service-level expectations. Procurement has also opened HS-0001983 for tracking — you can reference that in your legal packet.

If you can provide the SIG/CAIQ spreadsheet and the VPC PDF by 2026-09-02, procurement will prioritize legal review.

Best,
Lukas
--- Attachment: procurement_terms_medrec.pdf (2 pages) ---

From: tessa_morgan@redwood.com
To: Lukas Schneider <lukas.schneider@medrec.io>, procurement@medrec.io
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, rafael_mendes@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Date: 2026-09-02T16:04:00Z
Subject: Re: SIG & CAIQ + EU-only processing confirmation for marketplace onboarding

Hi Lukas / procurement team —

Thanks, all. Confirming our deliverables and timeline: 

1) Redwood_SIG_Response-v1.xlsx (SIG/CAIQ answers in spreadsheet) — attached and uploaded to shared Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3example
2) Redwood_VPC_Technical_Summary.pdf — attached (covers topology, control-plane vs data-plane separation, KMS options).
3) Marissa will prepare a DPA redline with SCCs and return by 2026-09-07; legal expects to track HS-0001983.
4) Rafael to run a 30-min technical Q&A on 2026-09-03 at 15:00 CET to walk through the VPC topology and key management options (invite to follow).

We are committed to pinning MedRec production tenants to EU-only compute and storage for the initial marketplace offering; backups/replication outside the EU will not occur without explicit contract language. We'll include that language in the DPA redline.

Let me know if procurement needs anything else for the legal packet. Looking forward to getting this over the finish line.

Cheers,
Tessa Morgan
Senior Strategic Sales Manager
Redwood Inference
